lookup_word_pronunciation: create a CMUDict instance and lookup ARPAbet pronunciations for a given word
parse_cmudict_file: parse a CMU Pronouncing Dictionary file into a word to pronunciation mapping
validate_pronunciation_symbols: validate that a pronunciation string contains only valid ARPAbet phoneme symbols
load_cmudict_without_ambiguous: load a CMUDict file keeping only words with a single unambiguous pronunciation
get_cmudict_entry_count: get the total number of word entries loaded in a CMUDict instance
